poll.source_locator: Study #27995 narrative: 'Osborn ... takes 46% today, while ... Ricketts takes 42%. 4% say they will vote for another candidate; 7% are undecided.'
poll.notes: D slot = Dan Osborn (Independent); Democrats fielded no nominee (Burbank withdrew July 2026, party backs Osborn). Read in user's Chrome (page renders in frames). 680 adults, 595 RV, 503 LV statewide.

pollster.weighting_quote: The full pool of respondents was weighted to US Census-derived targets for gender, age, ethnicity, education, and region, and to state of Nebraska voter registration statistics.
pollster.mode: mixed: online panel (Cint) 54%, IVR landline 17%, SMS-to-web 29%
